recovery.email.subject: Reset your {{.Tenant}} password
recovery.email.title: Reset your password
recovery.email.intro: Hello {{.Name}}. Somebody asked to reset the password for your account ({{.Username}}).
recovery.email.expiry: The link works once and expires in {{.Minutes}} minutes.
recovery.email.ignore: If this was not you, no action is needed — the password has not changed.
verification.email.subject: Confirm your {{.Tenant}} account
verification.email.title: Confirm your address
verification.email.intro: Hello {{.Name}}. An account ({{.Username}}) was registered with this address on {{.Tenant}}. Confirming the address is what finishes signing up.
verification.email.expiry: The link works once and expires in {{.Hours}} hours.
verification.email.ignore: If you did not register, no action is needed — the account cannot be used until somebody opens that link.
trial.confirm.subject: Confirm your Portico trial
trial.confirm.title: Confirm your trial
trial.confirm.intro: Somebody asked for a Portico trial for {{.Tenant}} using this address. Nothing has been created yet — opening the link below is what creates it.
trial.confirm.expiry: The link works once, and is good for {{.Hours}} hours.
trial.confirm.ignore: If that was not you, ignore this message. Nothing was created, and nothing will be.
trial.ready.subject: Your Portico trial: {{.Tenant}}
trial.ready.title: Your trial tenant is ready
trial.ready.intro: {{.Tenant}} has been created and is waiting for you. Here is everything you need to sign in for the first time.
trial.ready.recovery: This password is not stored anywhere it can be read back, so this message is the only copy. Your address is on the administrator account, though, so “forgot password” on the sign-in screen will reach you here.
trial.ready.demoBody: The tenant is filled with example people and applications. Every one of those accounts is an ordinary user and they all share one password — sign in as one to see what somebody who is not an administrator sees.
trial.ready.footer: This is a demonstration. Do not put anything real in it.
